web.title: import defer - JavaScript | MDN
web.description: The import defer declaration behaves like regular import declarations, except that it results in a deferred module namespace object. The module and its dependencies are fetched and linked up front, but their synchronous evaluation is deferred until the namespace's properties are accessed. Modules that use top-level await are evaluated eagerly.
